accounts_post_kind_length_range.name: accounts_post_kind_length_range
accounts_post_kind_length_range.value: "accounts"."short_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "accounts"."post_length_target" AND "accounts"."medium_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "accounts"."post_length_target" AND "accounts"."long_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "accounts"."post_length_target"

accounts_post_kind_ratio_range.name: accounts_post_kind_ratio_range
accounts_post_kind_ratio_range.value: "accounts"."short_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "accounts"."medium_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "accounts"."long_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "accounts"."short_ratio" + "accounts"."medium_ratio" + "accounts"."long_ratio" = 100

accounts_connection_consistency.name: accounts_connection_consistency
accounts_connection_consistency.value:
("accounts"."connection_status"::text = 'not_connected' AND "accounts"."threads_user_id" IS NULL AND "accounts"."username" IS NULL AND "accounts"."connection_method" IS NULL)
      OR ("accounts"."connection_status"::text <> 'not_connected' AND "accounts"."threads_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."username" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."connection_method" IS NOT NULL)

post_drafts_reject_reasons_valid.name: post_drafts_reject_reasons_valid
post_drafts_reject_reasons_valid.value:
"post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL OR (cardinality("post_drafts"."reject_reasons") >= 1
        AND array_position("post_drafts"."reject_reasons", NULL) IS NULL
        AND "post_drafts"."reject_reasons" <@ ARRAY['similar', 'tone', 'thin', 'inaccurate', 'too_promotional', 'policy']::text[])

post_drafts_review_state.name: post_drafts_review_state
post_drafts_review_state.value:
("post_drafts"."status"::text = 'needs_review' AND "post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("post_drafts"."status"::text IN ('approved', 'publishing') AND "post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("post_drafts"."status"::text = 'rejected' AND "post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND (coalesce(cardinality("post_drafts"."reject_reasons"), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(btrim("post_drafts"."reject_note"), '') <> '')
          AND "post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("post_drafts"."status"::text = 'published' AND "post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("post_drafts"."status"::text = 'publish_failed' AND "post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NOT NULL)

post_drafts_blocked_state.name: post_drafts_blocked_state
post_drafts_blocked_state.value:
("post_drafts"."blocked_at" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."blocked_reason" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."blocked_words" IS NULL)
        OR ("post_drafts"."status"::text = 'needs_review' AND "post_drafts"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_drafts"."blocked_reason" IS NOT NULL)

post_drafts_threads_media_state.name: post_drafts_threads_media_state
post_drafts_threads_media_state.value: ("post_drafts"."threads_media_id" IS NULL AND "post_drafts"."threads_permalink" IS NULL) OR "post_drafts"."status"::text = 'published'

post_metrics_judgment.name: post_metrics_judgment
post_metrics_judgment.value: "post_metrics"."judgment" IS NULL OR ("post_metrics"."state"::text IN ('confirmed', 'late_confirmed') AND "post_metrics"."judgment_ratio" IS NOT NULL AND "post_metrics"."judgment_baseline" > 0)

post_metrics_counts_nonnegative.name: post_metrics_counts_nonnegative
post_metrics_counts_nonnegative.value:
coalesce("post_metrics"."views", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("post_metrics"."likes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("post_metrics"."replies", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("post_metrics"."reposts", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("post_metrics"."quotes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("post_metrics"."shares", 0) >= 0

publish_attempts_skip_state.name: publish_attempts_skip_state
publish_attempts_skip_state.value:
("publish_attempts"."state" = 'skipped' AND "publish_attempts"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "publish_attempts"."draft_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("publish_attempts"."state" <> 'skipped' AND "publish_attempts"."skip_reason" IS NULL)

publish_attempts_pending_has_draft.name: publish_attempts_pending_has_draft
publish_attempts_pending_has_draft.value: "publish_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('in_progress', 'retry_wait') OR "publish_attempts"."draft_id" IS NOT NULL
